grader_disclosure: Model-assisted review conducted in a task-local, condition-masked context without inherited case-specific context. The reviewer read repository-root AGENTS.md and the assigned packet only for evidence; no mapping manifest, prior grades, retrieval outputs, source-support audit, web pages or unseen source pages were used. This is not independent human gold and does not claim statistical blindness. Shared model or project-development familiarity may remain.
status_semantics: The required-fact status supported_correct is a legacy label for frozen-reference semantic correctness. It does not assert support in the received context. Actual support is evaluated separately in citation_grounded, fact rationales, and unsupported_assertions, including for every material asserted addition.
grading_rules_applied: Frozen references and raw native answers were not modified.
No absent whole baseline was reconstructed from components, timing values, or model prior knowledge.
Interpretable document/page and grouped citations are accepted; supplied page content, not page identity alone, determines grounding.
Native output-limit failures remain a separate axis and do not automatically remove semantic fact credit.
Reference optional details are not mandatory, but asserted optional details are checked for grounding.

rubric_ambiguities.issue: Unchanged claim attached to a wrong baseline quantity
rubric_ambiguities.resolution: An explicit unchanged assertion receives narrow semantic retention credit even when its value and evidence concern the wrong quantity (case_30c3f4ee5efa). Only approximate consistency near 730 km with a claimed reporting shift is ambiguous retention (case_282a24f5c36b). Baseline content, scope and grounding still fail.

rubric_ambiguities.issue: Appropriate abstention when an answer mixes a justified limitation with unsupported material
rubric_ambiguities.resolution: Withholding the missing baseline value receives an abstention flag in case_66a1b1554431 while its unrelated assertion still fails grounding. A caveat about unknown change does not rescue case_d2a8459c32d4, which supplies a wrong requested baseline value. Partiality is disclosed in case notes.

rubric_ambiguities.issue: Missing required fact versus an incorrect substitute explanation
rubric_ambiguities.resolution: For the selection-reason fact, absence of the isolated-hit rule is marked missing. Incorrect substitute mechanisms and wrong-version attributions are preserved as scope errors, content failure, unsupported assertions and rationales.
The signed upper and lower systematic values are accepted when interpretable despite unconventional typesetting; an explicit symmetric plus/minus value is incorrect.

rubric_ambiguities.issue: No explicit answer-length threshold in assigned packet
rubric_ambiguities.resolution: Readability and interpretable citations determine format; no unstated word-count cap is invented. The one visibly unfinished answer fails format independently of its native limit flag.
